name: ES-CL Overlap Session Correlation
description: Rolling 30-bar correlation between ES and CL futures on 5-min bars during the US/EU overlap session (8:00-11:30 AM ET). Shows intra-session correlation evolution with regime bands highlighting periods of high positive correlation, decorrelation, and negative correlation.
source:
# ES-CL Rolling Correlation During US/EU Overlap (8:00-11:30 ET)
# 5-min bars, 30-bar rolling window (~2.5 hours of intra-session data)

# --- Data: ES (primary) and CL (reference) ---
es_raw = market_data_source(timeframe=5Min)()
es = futures_continuation(
    timeframe=5Min,
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardRatio
)(es_raw.o, es_raw.h, es_raw.l, es_raw.c, es_raw.v, es_raw.oi, es_raw.s)

cl_raw = reference_futures(ticker='CL')()
cl = futures_continuation(
    timeframe=5Min,
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardRatio
)(cl_raw.o, cl_raw.h, cl_raw.l, cl_raw.c, cl_raw.v, cl_raw.oi, cl_raw.s)

# --- Returns (close-to-close on 5-min bars) ---
es_ret = returns(period=1)(es.c)
cl_ret = returns(period=1)(ffill(cl.c))

# --- Session Window: US/EU Overlap 8:00-11:30 ET ---
overlap = session_window(
    session=Session(start='08:00', end='11:30', tz='America/New_York')
)(es.o, es.h, es.l, es.c)

# --- Rolling Correlation (30-bar window on returns) ---
corr_raw = rolling_corr(window=30, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(es_ret, cl_ret)

# Mask to session-only bars for clean visualization
corr_session = where(overlap.active, corr_raw)

# Session-end snapshot (one reading per day at 11:30 ET)
corr_at_close = where(overlap.closed and overlap.opened, corr_raw)

# --- Regime Classification ---
regime = conditional_select(
    is_valid(corr_raw) and corr_raw > 0.5, "High Positive",
    is_valid(corr_raw) and corr_raw > 0.0, "Low Positive",
    is_valid(corr_raw) and corr_raw > -0.5, "Low Negative",
    is_valid(corr_raw), "High Negative",
    "N/A"
)

# Detect correlation breakdowns (crosses below -0.3) and surges (above 0.7)
# crossunder()(a, threshold) fires when a drops below threshold
is_breakdown = crossunder()(corr_raw, -0.3) and overlap.active
# Manual cross-above: was at/below 0.7, now above 0.7
corr_lag = corr_raw >> 1
is_surge = (is_valid(corr_lag) and corr_lag <= 0.7 and corr_raw > 0.7) and overlap.active
is_event = is_breakdown or is_surge
event_label = conditional_select(is_breakdown, "Breakdown", "Surge")

# --- Output 1: Correlation Time Series with Regime Bands ---
ts = index()()

xy_lines(
    title="ES-CL Intra-Session Correlation (30-bar, 5Min)",
    category="ES-CL Overlap Correlation",
    y_axis_label="Correlation",
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Rolling Corr (30)", color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title="Zero"),
        ReferenceLine(value=0.5, color=Color.Emerald, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title="High +ve"),
        ReferenceLine(value=-0.5, color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title="High -ve")
    ]),
    y_plot_bands=PlotBandSchema(bands=[
        PlotBand(from=0.5, to=1.0, color=Color.Emerald, opacity=0.1, label="Strong +ve"),
        PlotBand(from=-1.0, to=-0.5, color=Color.Red, opacity=0.1, label="Strong -ve"),
        PlotBand(from=-0.2, to=0.2, color=Color.Gray, opacity=0.08, label="Decorrelated")
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=corr_session)

# --- Output 2: Session-End Correlation Distribution ---
histogram(
    title="Where Does Session-End Correlation Land?",
    category="ES-CL Overlap Correlation",
    bins=25,
    x_axis_label="Correlation at 11:30 ET",
    y_axis_label="Frequency",
    fill_color=Color.Blue,
    fill_opacity=0.6,
    show_analytics=True,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title="Zero")
    ]),
    order=2
)(corr_at_close)

# --- Output 3: Summary Stats ---
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    category="ES-CL Overlap Correlation",
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title="Session-End Correlation Stats (11:30 ET Snapshot)",
        row_size=3, col_size=2,
        row_headers=["Central Tendency", "Extremes", "Regime"],
        col_headers=["Metric", "Value"],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Std, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, dp=0)
        ]
    ),
    order=3
)(corr_at_close, corr_at_close, corr_at_close, corr_at_close, corr_at_close, corr_at_close)

# --- Event Markers: Correlation Extremes ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Correlation Extreme',
        icon=Icon.ActivityIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Type', type=CardRenderType.BadgeFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(title='Correlation', dp=3, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='ES Price', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(event_label, corr_raw, es.c, is_event)
